core.title: Vertical Rod Dummy Exit Device, PDQ 4200V-B605-DUM

text.description_html:
Dummy/non active Exit Device

Features and Specifications: for Polished Brass Vertical Rod non Active Exit Device:

  • Chassis: Cadmium plated steel
  • Rail: Heavy gauge steel or stainless steel
  • Touch Pad: Heavy gauge steel or stainless steel
  • Stile Width: 4-1/4" minimum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Width: Standard for 2'6"- 3'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door. (Optional 1' extension rod [up to 8' High Door] or 3' [up to 10' High Door] extension rod)
  • Certifications: U.L./U.L.C. listed for "Panic", "Fire Exit Hardware" labeled for up to 1-1/2 hour for 3'0" x 7'0" maximum single, 6'0" x 7'0" maximum pairs / Complies with U.L. 10C and UBC 7.2 (1997)
  • Finish: 605 (US3) Polished Brass
